title: SubtitleTrack
description: Output of the Subtitle System (services/post-processing SubtitleGenerator): one language's caption track for a project, serializable to SRT/WebVTT or burned into the master video by the Render Compositor.

style_preset_id.description: Key into the Subtitle System's styling preset registry (font/size/color/position) - used only when burned_in=true.

burned_in.description: Whether this track should be rendered into the video pixels (vs. shipped as a soft-subtitle SRT/VTT file).
